correctness.rationale: The proof independently reconstructs exact partial-transpose blocks and Schmidt eigenvalues in all D, reduces the difference to a one-variable symmetric expression, proves its sign and strict convexity/concavity, and proves strict monotonicity of the one-dimensional critical-point equation. Two asymptotically matching elementary bounds establish the exact sharp square-root coefficient. The embedded SymPy program directly reconstructs partial transposes at D=2,3,4,5, checks key identities and evaluates scalar maxima; no finite test is used as an infinite proof. Boundary cases are explicitly separated.

value.rationale: The additive sharing deficit is a motivated invariant on a standard tripartite W-vacuum family already central to an entanglement-monogamy study. The exact sign threshold and unique global optimizer settle the full finite-dimensional family, and the nontrivial √D growth coefficient quantifies a dimension-dependent subleading phenomenon absent from the leading source expansion. Neither a routine substitution nor an arbitrary isolated number.
